steps.name: Wedding event contract execution commences
steps.annotation: Four-party contract involving couple and vendors A, B, C

steps.name: Install furniture and tenting on schedule
steps.annotation: Prior to wedding event; must not delay more than 1 hour or disrupt schedule
steps.fallbackQuestion: Is furniture and tenting installed on schedule?

steps.name: Issue 25% rental fee credit for minor delay
steps.annotation: Delay > 1 hour but no disruption to event; payable within 7 business days
steps.fallbackQuestion: Is delivery delay non-disruptive to event schedule?

steps.name: Issue 50% refund for schedule disruption
steps.annotation: Delay directly disrupts event schedule by more than 30 minutes

steps.name: Operate audio-visual and lighting equipment
steps.annotation: During wedding event before guests eat and socialize
steps.fallbackQuestion: Are AV apparatus and lighting operating without defect?

steps.name: Provide functional replacement within 90 minutes
steps.annotation: Remedy equipment failure on-site within 90 minutes
steps.fallbackQuestion: Is functional replacement equipment provided within 90 minutes?

steps.name: Issue 80% refund plus $300 failure fee
steps.annotation: Failure to remedy on-site results in 80% rental refund plus $300 failure fee
steps.fallbackQuestion: Is 80% refund and $300 fee compensation available?

steps.name: Serve scheduled courses and meals
steps.annotation: During last hour of event according to agreed timeline
steps.fallbackQuestion: Are meals delivered on time and consumable?

steps.name: Supply alternative meal from backup menu
steps.annotation: Alternative meal supplied per previously specified back-up menu

steps.name: Issue 100% refund plus $500 liquidated damages
steps.annotation: 100% catering refund plus liquidated damages up to $500 within 5 business days
steps.fallbackQuestion: Is full catering refund and liquidated damages available?

steps.name: Wedding fulfilled with compliant catering and vendor services
Wedding fulfilled via backup catering remedy
Wedding completed via full catering refund and liquidated damages
